definition: The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) [ˈɒnɪks] is an open-source artificial intelligence ecosystem of technology companies and research organizations that establish open standards for representing machine learning algorithms and software tools to enable a standard format for representing machine learning models.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Open Neural Network Exchange.
